$comment: WS2 rows: hatch tunables, the equalize-pressure order on hatches, and the hatch texts.

General/Settings/Damage Control.$comment: H1, D1: atm by which the seat side may exceed the far side (water head 0.1 atm/m) before the hatch locks.

H4: base air/water exchange rate k through hatches at 1x time (02 §2.3b), a multiplier on both. The default 2 makes open-hatch water flow match vanilla 2026.1 (2 m3/s per metre of level difference at 1x); closed leaks stay 2 % of it.
H5, D7: per-second chance that over-pressure blows a destroyed hatch open.

Locales/Activators.English: Bleed air and water through this hatch until both sides are close enough in pressure to open it, then open it.
The pressure difference is holding this hatch shut.
This hatch is wrecked and leaking. Its seal will hardly hold more than a few atmospheres.
Partly sealed: the leak is much smaller.
